1A
UVA PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
Appointments made by the Governor of Uva Province

BY virtue of powers vested to me by Section 32(1) of the Provincial Council Act, No. 42 of 1947, I, M. P. Jayasinghe,Governor of Uva Province do hereby notify that the following appointments have been approved by me.
1) Mr. W. M. M. G. Abeysinghe Banda, Class I Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, as Secretary to
the Ministry of Sports and Youth Affairs, Tourism, Transport, Cultural Affairs and Textiles and Small Industriesof Uva Province, with immediate effect from the date 17.02.2016 ;
2) Mr. D. M. L. Bandaranayake, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Administative Service, as Deputy Chief
Secretary (Personnel and Training) of Uva Province, with immediate effect from the date 17.02.2016 ;
3) Mrs. R. M. L. C. Abesinghe, Class III Officer of the Sri Lanka Planning Service to perform the Duties of the
Director of Sports of Uva Province, from the date 04.02.2016 to 19.02.2016, till the return of Mrs. GeethaNandani Pathiranawasam to the Island, who is the Director of Sports of Uva Province.
4) Mr. B. M. K. G. Bandara, Class III Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, to perform the Duties of

the Provincial Commissioner of Local Government of Uva Province, in addition to his Permanent Post,from the date 21.03.2016 to 29.03.2016, till the return of Mr. M. M. Wijenayake to the Island, who is theProvincial Commissioner of Local Government of Uva Province.
5) Mr. H. M. Jayarathna, Grade I Officer of the Sri Lanka Engineering Servicce, to perform the Duties of the

Director to Building of Uva Province, in addition to his Permanent Post, from the date 13.03.2016 to25.03.2016 till the return of Mr. P. S. S. Withanage to the Island, who is the Acting Director to Building ofUva Province.
6) Mr. H. M. Jayarathna, Grade I Officer of the Sri Lanka Engineering Service, to perform the Duties of the

Deputy Chief Secretary (Engineering Service) of the Uva Province, in addition to his Permanent Post, fromthe date 19.03.2016 to 26.03.2016, till the return of Engineer Mr. A. P. S. K. Karunarathne, to the Island,who is the Deputy Chief Secretary (Engineering Service).

7) Mrs. R. M. S. D. Rathnayake, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, as Deputy Chief
Secretary (Administration) of Uva Province, with effect from the date 01.07.2015 ;
8) Mr. B. M. K. G. Bandara, Class III Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, to perform the Duties of

the Provincial Commissioner of Local Government of Uva Province, in addition to his permanent post, fromthe date 08.05.2016 to 18.05.2016, till the return of Mr. M. M. Wijenayake to the Island who is the ProvincialCommissioner of Local Government of Uva Province ;
9) Mrs. G. W. C. S. Priyabashini, Class III Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, to perform the

Duties of the Municipal Commissioner of the Badulla Municipal Council, in addition to her permanent post,from the date 08.05.2016 to 18.05.2016, till the return of Mr. W. Randeniya to the Island who is the MunicipalCommissioner of the Badulla Municipal Council.
10) Mr. R. M. D. K. K. Wimalachandra, Class III Officer of the Sri Lanka Agricultural Service, to act as Deputy
Agriculture Director Bindunuwewa Inservice Training Institute, with immediate effect from the date12.07.2016 ;
11) Enigneer Mr. G. S. S. Withanage, Grade I Officer of the Sri Lanka Engineering Service, to perform the Duties

of the Deputy Chief Secretary (Engineering Service) of Uva Province, in addition to his permanent post,from the date 01.07.2016 to 06.07.2016, till the return of Engineer Mr. A. A. P. S. K. Karunarathne, to theIsland who is Deputy Chief Secretary (Eingeering Service) of Uva Province ;
12) Mr. G. A. Ariyasena Gurusingha, Class III Officer of the Sri Lanka Agricultural Service, to act as Assistant
Deputy Agriculture Director of Badulla Assistant Agricultural Office ;
13) Colonization Officer Mr. L. S. Rohana Dharmasena, to act as Assistant Land Commissioner of Land
Commissioner Department of Uva Province, with immediate effect from the date 04.07.2016 ;
14) Mr. J. A. S. P. Jayasinghe, Class III Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, as Secretary to the
Haputhale Municipal Council, from the date 29.07.2016 ;
15) Mr. L. L. Anil Wijesiri, Class I Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, to act as Commissioner of
Co-operative Development of Department of Co-operative Development for Uva Province, with effect fromthe date 29.07.2016.
M. P. JAYASINGHE,Governor of Uva Province.
Office of the Governor of Uva Province,01st August, 2016.
